diagnosis: The shopping cart retrieval endpoint uses Redis OM's CartOrderDraft.get(cart_pk) to fetch cart records. It fails to check whether cart.customer_id matches current_user.id, allowing an attacker who enumerates or obtains cart_pk keys to view saved physical addresses, items, and payment token references of other customers.
exploit_request:
GET /ecommerce/carts/01HJ8Z910MKA789BCDW124890 HTTP/1.1
Host: shop.storefront.com
Authorization: Bearer <customer_jwt>
